sections.title: Horror, Mystery, Suspense
sections.description: Students should come prepared to read a wide range of speculative fiction in horror, mystery, and suspense, and to craft their own canny, uncanny, and original contributions to the genres of slow-ratcheted, nigh-unbearable tension and white-knuckle, heart-pounding terror. To learn more about this course, visit the Creative Writing Program at https://creative.writing.upenn.edu.
